parsed.why: No criminalisation and no trans-specific visitor exposure documented, but hate-crime enforcement fails: attacks downgraded, police close cases, prosecutor must reopen. Dated clerical hostility and low regional ranking offset courts that partially work; thin trans record limits credit.

Protective machinery operating: marriage equality, GI anti-discrimination, hate-speech law, arrests of a 150-person mob, prison transfers on petition. Offset by a 2024 mob attack on trans people, discontinued police-mistreatment complaints, and survey data showing broad caution and avoidance.

Sodomy statute upheld in 2024, reaching gender-nonconforming people directly: trans woman convicted to eight years in a men's prison. Documented arbitrary police arrests, assaults, forced stripping and exams, medical denial, presidential threats and death-penalty calls. State is perpetrator.

No criminalisation and anti-discrimination/hate-crime laws exist, but unenforced: police assault and sexual harassment of LGBT people with no sanction, 20-plus unsanctioned attacks closing an LGBT centre, unmet custody-search recommendation, and pervasive hostile public opinion with thin recourse.

Fully permissive framework: protected facility access, self-ID, GI hate-crime aggravation, conversion-ban, high public support. Rollback bills reached only first reading and are contested by institutions and public; no documented traveler-facing restriction in force.
